ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The figure below is a schematic diagram of the food web of an artificial fishpond and its energy transfer (the numbers in the figure are energy values, in units of J*m^-2*a^-1). How much energy is consumed by the respiration of sunfish? (unit J*m^-2*a^-1)
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The energy value marked inside the "sunfish" box in the figure is 1483; the energy value marked on the arrow from "sunfish" to the predator "bass" on the right is 126. Then reason: According to the energy budget relationship, the energy assimilated or obtained by sunfish = energy consumed by respiration + energy transferred to the next trophic level. Therefore, the energy consumed by the respiration of sunfish = 1483 - 126 = 1357 J·m^-2·a^-1.
